title: Fantastic Cooking Class - Delicious Food.
text:
Fantastic experience. Zara was so professional, personable, extremely knowledgeable and very easy to be around. We have done quite a few cooking classes and this totally exceeded our expectations, great value for money and was the best by far, so much so that we talked about this class on the cruise we took following the class and have recommended it to many others. 
Her studio and setup is very appealing, she has fun photos, maps, areas to relax, plus every cool cooking gadget available.  Thank you Zara for making this such a great, fun experience.
author: didouk4149

title: Cannot recommend Zara and her paella making/Sabrage activity enough - OUTSTANDING!
text: Our host, Zara, was the star of the show.  A fantastic and natural facilitator, she MADE our family reunion be the most memorable event for our family visitors from Australia and our children (there were 8 of us - 4 of us in our 60's and 4 in their 30's).  She was SO welcoming and her Academy room is perfect with lots of interesting memorabilia.  Launching straight into paella making as we arrived, with crisp aprons for everyone and wonderfully organised chopping for all, we enjoyed chatting and listening to her explain the paella making steps. author: mandyenglishceramics

title: A True Paella-Making Experience
text: We loved learning to make paella with Zara. We took a private class with wine pairing and really enjoyed actually learning to make paella from start to finish, rather than just focusing on the prep. There are a lot of details in the process and I am very glad to have gotten first-hand experience.  We went with a traditional Valencian paella, but Zara explains how to make a similar base and then make different styles when you make them in the future. author: AKKirkwood

title: Wonderful night cooking with Zara
text: We made Vegan and Mixed paella. Zara's kindness and patience were evident. She took us through stock, chopping the veg, sofrito, all the way through completed paella and a pitcher of Sangria. We will definitely try to book another class the next time we are in Barcelona.
author: limdae

title: Amazing night with Zara  - 10/10
text:
We spent an evening with Zara at Savour Academy as part of a trip to Barcelona to celebrate a 40th Birthday. We were looking for something different to do, something beyond a bar or restaurant. This didn't dissapoint!

We had so much fun doing sabrage and Zara is so knowledgeable, while being great fun. It was such a memorable experience. Delicious food and beautiful cava. Would recommend to everyone.
author: nolanlondon2015

title: Amazing!!!!!
text: What an amazing day!!! Thank you Zara for putting together such a great experience. I highly recommend Savour Academy!
author: davidedelson

title: Fun and informative experience
text: I attended with a group of friends and we had the most Amazing time!  Zara was patient with us in learning to sabrage.  The paella turned out fantastic! I highly recommend taking this course for a fun and informative time.
author: Michelle P

title: THE Most Fun Class
text: All-around fantastic and one-of-a-kind class! Successfully added sabering cava to the list of party tricks (how many people get to say that?!) and learned how to make one of the most authentic dishes from Spain. Zara was the perfect teacher: experienced and fun!
author: 715joyb

title: Saber off the top of your cava bottle?!? Yes please!
text: A wonderfully unique experience! I never thought I would chop off the top of a cava bottle with a saber!!! Zara was a great teacher, instilling confidence in us and encouraging the group! She set up a great social environment while we were able to chat and enjoy a little “pica pica” in a relaxed environment before making and devouring a delicious paella! I would highly recommend this activity and any other that Zara offers!
author: socal179

title: Paella and cava tasts  better in barcelona
text:
It was a very nice and delicious experience!!
I would recommend the place. Even though it was a bit tight on the time schedule sometimes. I'll be back for another cooking session to learn something new
author: Mariell S
